'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Russo-Ukrainian war]]
**[[Dnipro strikes (2022–present)|Dnipro strikes]], [[Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure (2022–present)|Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure]]
***[[Russian Armed Forces|Russia]] strikes [[Dnipro]], Ukraine, with a projectile stated by [[President of Russia|Russian President]] [[Vladimir Putin]] to be a new [[Oreshnik (missile)|Oreshnik]] [[intermediate-range ballistic missile]] (IRBM) model. This confirms earlier reports from the [[United States]] and other western officials, who said that Russia had used an IRBM after initial reports misidentified the missile as a [[RS-26 Rubezh]] [[intercontinental ballistic missile]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russia-launches-intercontinental-ballistic-missile-attack-ukraine-kyiv-says-2024-11-21/ (Reuters)] [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/russia-ukraine-war-missiles-kyiv-claims-icbm-dnipro-after-atacams-strike/ (CBS News)] [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/c20726y20kvt?post=asset%3A47fd8644-8538-475d-a3cc-6f5714f0d191#post (BBC News)]
**[[Hungary and the Russo-Ukrainian war]]
***[[Hungary]] announces the deployment of a [[missile defense]] system on [[Hungary–Ukraine border|its border]] with [[Ukraine]], saying that the threat of escalation with [[Russia]] is now "greater than ever". [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/hungary-install-air-defence-system-near-ukraine-border-2024-11-21/ (Reuters)]
**[[United Kingdom and the Russo-Ukrainian war]]
***[[List of ambassadors of Russia to the United Kingdom|Russian ambassador]] to the [[United Kingdom]] [[Andrey Kelin]] says that the UK is now "directly involved" in the war in Ukraine following yesterday's use of British [[Storm Shadow]] [[cruise missile]]s by Ukraine to strike targets inside Russia. [https://news.sky.com/story/britain-directly-involved-in-ukraine-war-russian-ambassador-tells-sky-news-13257896 (Sky News)]
*[[Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]], [[Sectarian violence in Pakistan]]
**[[2024 Kurram attack]]
***At least 42 people are killed and many others are wounded as gunmen [[Mass shooting|open fire]] against two convoys carrying [[Shia Islam|Shia]] people in [[Kurram District]], [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/11/22/dozens-killed-in-sectarian-violence-in-pakistans-khyber-pakhtunkhwa (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
**[[Hezbollah]] fires a rocket barrage at [[Northern District (Israel)|northern]] [[Israel]], killing one person in the city of [[Nahariya]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/man-killed-rocket-attack-northern-israeli-town-israeli-medics-say-2024-11-21/ (Reuters)]
*[[Colombian conflict]]
**Five [[Colombian Army|soldiers]] are killed and four other people are injured after a bombing attack in the municipality of [[Anorí]], [[Antioquia Department]], [[Colombia]]. The [[National Liberation Army (Colombia)|National Liberation Army]] is blamed. [https://elpais.com/america-colombia/2024-11-21/el-eln-asesina-a-cinco-soldados-cerca-de-un-espacio-de-reincorporacion-en-antioquia-a-dos-anos-del-inicio-de-los-dialogos-de-paz.html (El País)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 Laos methanol poisoning]]
**An [[Australian people|Australian]] and a [[British people|British]] tourist die after [[Methanol toxicity|consuming poisoned alcohol]] in [[Vang Vieng]], [[Laos]], bringing the death toll from the incident to five. Nine others are hospitalized. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cx27wyrxz9yo (BBC News)] [https://apnews.com/article/australian-laos-thailand-alcohol-poisoning-american-new-zealand-d44a61c3a12bbee4fd917346493d7f94 (AP)]

'''Health and environment'''
*The [[Ministry of Health (New Zealand)|Ministry of Health]] of [[New Zealand]] declares a national [[epidemic]] of [[whooping cough]] after a recent spike of 263 cases in the past four weeks. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/news/national/534519/new-zealand-declares-whooping-cough-epidemic (RNZ)]

'''International relations'''
*[[International sanctions during the Russian invasion of Ukraine]], [[Russia–United States relations]]
**[[United States Secretary of the Treasury|U.S. Treasury Secretary]] [[Janet Yellen]] announces that the [[United States Department of the Treasury|Treasury Department]] has imposed sanctions against [[Russia]]'s third-largest bank [[Gazprombank]] and its subsidiaries. '''Law and crime'''
*[[2022 Brazilian coup plot]]
**[[Brazil]]ian [[Federal Police (Brazil)|Federal Police]] indicts former [[President of Brazil|President]] [[Jair Bolsonaro]] and 36 others for attempting a [[coup]] after he lost to [[Lula da Silva]] in the [[2022 Brazilian presidential election|2022 election]]. [https://apnews.com/article/brazil-jair-bolsonaro-indictment-0d62fe0a7399483aee48cf3c845560ea (AP)]
*[[Novi Sad railway station canopy collapse]]
**Eleven people, including former [[Ministry of Construction, Transport and Infrastructure (Serbia)|construction minister]] [[Goran Vesić]], are arrested as part of an investigation into the [[Novi Sad railway station]] accident that caused 15 deaths earlier this month. [https://www.dw.com/en/serbian-train-station-collapse-prompts-wave-of-arrests/a-70854872 (DW)] [https://al24news.com/en/serbia-arrests-11-over-fatal-train-station-accident/ (AL24)]

***The [[International Criminal Court]] issues arrest warrants for [[Prime Minister of Israel|Israeli Prime Minister]] [[Benjamin Netanyahu]], former [[Ministry of Defense (Israel)|Israeli minister of defense]] [[Yoav Gallant]], and the leader of [[Hamas]]' [[Al-Qassam Brigades|military wing]] [[Mohammed Deif]], who is presumed to be dead. '''Science and technology'''
*[[Internet censorship in Pakistan]]
**It is reported that [[Pakistan]] internet authorities have banned the use of [[Bluesky]] in the country amidst a surge in popularity in the app. The ban is confirmed by internet watchdog [[NetBlocks]] in a post on [[Twitter under Elon Musk|X]] (formerly known as [[Twitter]]). [https://www.techradar.com/pro/vpn/pakistan-blocks-bluesky-amid-popularity-surge (TechRadar)]
*The [[European Southern Observatory]] announces that its astronomers in [[Chile]] capture the first close-up image of a [[WOH G64|star]] outside the [[Milky Way]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/2024/11/21/science/behemoth-star-closeup-picture.html (''The New York Times'')]
